import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        print(0)
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    # Ensure we have enough numbers; if not, use what's available
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    even_count = sum(1 for x in arr if x % 2 == 0)
    print(even_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
